purpose: deterministic visual triage and identity review only; not final facial-action onset measurement

commons_hugging_2019.reason: short primary affiliative clip; dense review sampling while preserving a small inspectable contact-sheet pack

commons_tomcats_conflict_2020.reason: long non-affiliative control; broad identity/activity triage before any separately frozen full-rate event review

rules.selection: take frame index 0, every step_frames frame, and the final decoded frame
rules.timing_authority: ffprobe best_effort_timestamp_time for decoded video frames; nominal FPS is diagnostic only
rules.pixel_identity: SHA-256 of ffmpeg-decoded RGB24 bytes for every selected frame
rules.review_artifact: lossless PNG plus contact sheets; PNG is for review, RGB24 hash is the pixel-identity channel
rules.fine_review_requirement: any candidate facial-action interval must later be reviewed at native decoded-frame cadence and bound to the same raw-media SHA-256
rules.negative_preservation: reviewed intervals with no admissible event remain in the ledger

claim_ceiling: Passing this policy establishes a deterministic, replayable frame ledger and review pack only. It does not establish cat identity, 48-landmark accuracy, CatFACS action onset, or delta-t.
